ArtifactStage.title: ArtifactStage

ArtifactSummary.description:
A lightweight, presentation-facing pointer to one produced artifact.

References an ArtifactRef by id rather than duplicating its full record
(see f.libraries.lineage.models.ArtifactRef) — this is what a result
envelope shows a user, not the authoritative artifact store entry.

description.description: Short, human-facing description of what this artifact is.
description.title: Description

ArtifactSummary.title: ArtifactSummary

CapabilityChange.description: One capability-lifecycle change (architecture/adr/0002) this task caused.
CapabilityChange.title: CapabilityChange

ExecutionType.description:
What kind of work this result describes.

`windmill_job` — task code ran through Windmill (architecture/adr/0001's
exclusive execution boundary); `conversational` — Hermes answered,
explained, or drafted text without executing anything (ADR 0001's
explicit exception).
ExecutionType.title: ExecutionType

WindmillJobRef.description: Points at the Windmill job that proves a windmill_job result actually ran.

path.description: Script or flow path that ran.
path.title: Path

WindmillJobRef.title: WindmillJobRef

description: The standard envelope Hermes uses to present one task's outcome.

capability_version.description: Version of workflow_path that ran, if known.
capability_version.title: Capability Version

failure_summary.description: Actionable explanation of what went wrong and, where possible, what to do about it. Required when outcome is failure.
failure_summary.title: Failure Summary

job.description: The Windmill job that proves this ran. Required whenever outcome is success or partial for a windmill_job result. May be absent for a failure that occurred before a job could be submitted (e.g. Windmill unreachable) or for a conversational result, where it must always be absent.

schema_version.description: Schema MAJOR.MINOR this record was written against.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

workflow_path.description: Windmill script/flow path that ran. Required when execution_type is windmill_job; always None for conversational results.
workflow_path.title: Workflow Path
